_about: What a stand-and-craft station shows in the world (StationState). `busy` parts show only while a craft runs at the station (a survivor's StationCraft on it, or a ProcessStation job); `idle` parts only while it is empty; `body` parts always, and only when the kind has no model of its own (the forge has no GLB yet, so its hearth is built here). Part: mesh box|cyl|sphere|capsule, size [x,y,z] (cyl/capsule: [radius, height, 0]; sphere: [radius, height, 0]), pos, rot (degrees), color, optional emit (emission energy). `light` and `sparks` are busy-only. Process stations (drying rack, smoker, crock pot, steamer) keep processing.json's stages/contents; fires (campfire, bonfire, stone fire pit) are claude/mmo-firefuel's. # ASSUMPTION: no tanning frame or oven kind is buildable yet, so neither has a row; adding the kind later is one row here.

work_anim._about: Station kind -> the survivor's work loop while they run a job there: PlayerAnim.play_work(kind) plays clip work_<kind> (claude/mmo-rummage). # ASSUMPTION: mortar, anvil, well and the process stations' loading use the nearest fitting loop.
